# Role Responsibility Template

Use this template when adding or updating role entries in docs/octoacme-roles-and-personas.md

- Role name:
- Role summary: (1–2 sentence summary)
- Responsibilities:
  - [ ] Responsibility 1
  - [ ] Responsibility 2
- Typical interactions:
  - Works with: (roles)
  - Handoff points: (planning -> execution, execution -> release, etc.)
- Goals / success metrics:
- Typical communications and cadence:
- Example artifacts / outputs:
  - e.g., user research report, PRs, test plan, runbook
